benchmark.name: ToolSandbox
benchmark.scenarios: All 1,032 official scenarios (129 base x 8 tool variants), built after random.seed(42) as in the official CLI
benchmark.loop: Official Scenario.play_and_evaluate, max_messages from each scenario

user_simulator.prompt: ToolSandbox's scenario prompts and few-shot demonstrations, unchanged
user_simulator.end_with_text: Text accompanying end_conversation is delivered; that end call is ignored.

clock.unit: Every actor turn containing tool calls; user-facing replies are not reviewed
clock.randomization: Independent Bernoulli per decision, seeded per episode
clock.environment_time: Fixed at episode admission, America/Los_Angeles; shared by scenario construction, tools and evaluation; persisted before calls and reused on infrastructure retry

intervention.treatment: Review the frozen proposal, then execute the validated next action
intervention.invalid_delivery: Execute the original proposal and retain assignment

outcome: Official ToolSandbox similarity, set to zero when a minefield matches.
